title: PosMerchantData

merchant_id.description: The Grubhub or third-party provided external ID for the merchant. Corresponds to a single location.

name.description: The display name of the merchant.

service_type.description: Merchant configuration for providing food to diner. This can be one of the following: - "PICKUP" - Merchant supports pickup only orders. - "DELIVERY" - Merchant supports delivery only orders. - "DELIVERY AND PICKUP" - Merchant supports both delivery and pickup orders.

additionalProperties.description: Merchant status by order type (e.g., STANDARD, CATERING, GROUP).

merchant_status_by_order_type.description: Merchant status by order type (e.g., STANDARD, CATERING, GROUP).

description: Summary information about a merchant. This entity will be expanded over time.

locality.description: City, town, village or any variant thereof

region.description: State, province or any variant thereof. 2 digit ISO code for US states.

postal_code.description: ISO standard postal code, varies per country

county.description: County, parish or any variant thereof

county_id.description: The unique identifier for the county this merchant is located in

country.description: Country, territory or any variant thereof

market.description: The market that this merchant is enrolled within

market_id.description: The id of the market that this merchant is enrolled within

time_zone.description: A human readable description of what time zone this address is in

confidence_rating.description: How confident geocoder is that this address is accurate

confirmed_address.description: Whether the address has been confirmed to be accurate

Address.description: The address of the physical location for a merchant.

name.description: A name for the delivery zone

fee_cents.description: The delivery cost for this delivery zone, in cents

zone_type.description: They type of delivery zone (i.e. Diner or Catering). Defaults to Diner

geometry.description: GeoJSON String representing the geometry of the delivery area

DeliveryAreaStats.description: Various Calculations about a DeliveryArea, Filled automatically. All units are in miles/square miles.

offers_curbside_pickup.description: Describes whether merchant is opted in to curbside pickup or not.

contact_phone.description: Means of contacting a merchant when picking up curbside.

curbside_instructions.description: An additional information a merchant can optionally provide to curbside pickup diners.

DinerPickUpInstructions.description: Contains diner pickup instructions for a merchant.

GeoLocation.description: Latitude and longitude coordinates for a location.

scheduled_orders.description: Whether or not the merchant is opt-in scheduled ordering.

pos_integrated.description: Whether or not the merchant is pos integrated.

OrderProcessingInfo.description: Contains order processing info of a merchant.

managed_delivery.description: Whether or not the merchant is managed delivery enabled.

special_instructions_disabled.description: Describes whether this merchant has disabled special ordering instructions or not.

driver_pickup_instructions.description: Describes how a delivery driver should pick up orders from merchant.

OrderTakingInfo.description: Contains order taking info for a merchant.

merchant_status.description: The merchant's current status concerning account creation or ability to receive orders in a machine-readable format

merchant_status_descriptor.description: The merchant's current status concerning account creation or ability to receive orders in a human-readable format

pos_merchant_status.description: The merchant's current status concerning account creation or ability to receive orders (online/offline)

reason.description: Reason explaining why the merchant has a given status

holds_active_account.description: Whether or not this merchant should be regarded as holding an active account with GrubHub

accepting_phone_orders.description: Whether or not this merchant is currently capable of receiving orders by phone

accepting_online_orders.description: Whether or not this merchant is currently capable of receiving orders that have been transmitted online

merchant_status_comments.description: The reason that this merchant is in the status it is in, typically reserved for merchants not conducting business

PosAccountStatus.description: The current state of the merchant with regards to work flow and how they are conducting business.

value.description: The value of the fee applied for a service, in percentage of total order value or US dollars.

type.description: Whether or not a fee value is applied as a percentage of order value or a whole amount of US dollars. Possible values are FLAT or PERCENT

PosDeliveryFee.description: A fee that is applied to a merchant for the delivery service.

pickup_estimate_minutes.description: Default number of minutes that this merchant requires between confirming an order and it being ready for pickup, if applicable.

delivery_estimate_minutes.description: Default number of minutes that this merchant requires between confirming an order and completion of delivery, if applicable.

pos_estimates.description: The merchant's pickup and delivery estimates.

delivery_minimum.description: The minimum dollar value a merchant requires for an order to be eligible for delivery.

active_delivery_areas.description: A list of delivery areas including the delivery fee for each zone.

PosMerchantFulfillmentInfo.description: Contains pickup and delivery info for a merchant.
